associations.title: Hub associations
associations.hint: A workflow can belong to multiple Hubs without duplication. Association review does not publish the workflow, list it in the market or award experience.
associations.reason: Application explanation or review reason (visible to the author)
associations.cauHint: Explain its specific use, campus context or partnership at CAU in at least 20 characters. Relevance is reviewed manually; this is not university identity verification.
associations.unavailable: The workflow must be independently reviewed and published before its author can request an association.
associations.official: The platform configures official recipe associations; members cannot change them.
associations.saved: The server confirmed this operation. The refreshed status is authoritative.
associations.pending: The result is unconfirmed. Recover this original request instead of creating another application.
associations.oldApproval: The previously approved exact version remains valid. A new request does not automatically replace it.
associations.approve: Confirm relevance and include in Hub
associations.withdrawText: Withdraw only this selected consent. Other requests, the workflow and market card remain.
associations.leaveText: You can recover your explanation and original request in the same tab and account. Refreshing or closing the browser may lose them.
associations.queueHint: Catalog management permission is required. Review real relevance and an exact approved workflow version. Self review is forbidden; CAU relevance is not university identity verification.
associations.loadUnavailable: Member workflows are unavailable; their count is unknown. Try again later.
associations.market: View this exact version in the market
associations.versionChanged: The published version changed. Clear the previous explanation and confirm the new version before requesting.

errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Could not retrieve current status or complete the operation. Retry; unconfirmed requests keep their original identifier.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.ACCOUNT_CHANGED: The account changed. Operations for the old account stopped.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this workflow or Hub review.
errors.OFFICIAL_WORKFLOW_LOCKED: Members cannot change official platform recipes.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Select a Hub and exact version, and provide a sufficient explanation.
errors.REVISION_CONFLICT: The application changed. Reload and review it.
errors.REVIEWED_VERSION_REQUIRED: Choose the currently public, independently approved exact version.
errors.SELF_REVIEW_FORBIDDEN: An independent administrator must review your application.
errors.INVALID_STATE: This action is unavailable in the current state. Reload it.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: The original identifier conflicts with its content. Contact an administrator.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The workflow or application does not exist.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Recover the original request later.

associations.authorOnly: Only the author can submit a new Hub association request.
